 await t.test('OPERATIONAL READERS lifecycle is read-only and scoped',async()=>{for(const suffix of ['precheck','backup',''])await q(await read('../supabase/folha_operacional_contextos'+(suffix?'_'+suffix:'')+'.sql'));await q(await read('../supabase/folha_operacional_contextos_postcheck.sql'));await q(await read('../supabase/folha_operacional_contextos_rollback.sql'));await q(await read('../supabase/folha_operacional_contextos.sql'));await q(await read('../supabase/folha_operacional_contextos_postcheck.sql'));});
 const dayContext=(actor,person,work=100,kind='primeline')=>as(a,actor,'SELECT fn_folha_dia_contexto_v3($1::date,$2::uuid,$3::uuid,$4::text) v',[today,id(work),typeof person==='number'?id(person):person,kind]);
 await t.test('OPERATIONAL READERS preserve authorized whole-day facts, source reference read-only, hidden works withheld',async()=>{const admin=await dayContext(10,777);assert.equal(admin.records.length,2);assert.equal(admin.references.length,1);assert.equal(admin.hidden_record_count,0);assert.equal(admin.reference.confirmed,true);assert.equal(admin.reference.day.expected_minutes,480);assert.equal(admin.reference_edit_capability,false);const foreman=await dayContext(13,777);assert.equal(foreman.records.length,1);assert.equal(foreman.hidden_record_count,1);assert.ok(foreman.records.every(x=>x.obra_id!==id(102)));assert.equal(foreman.can_write,true);const gerencia=await dayContext(11,777);assert.equal(gerencia.can_write,false);});
 await t.test('OPERATIONAL READERS works include closed warranty choice by UUID, other tenant rejected',async()=>{const works=await as(a,13,'SELECT fn_folha_destinos_contexto_v3() v',[]);assert.equal(works.works.find(x=>x.id===id(101)).status,'fechada');assert.ok(works.works.every(x=>x.id!==id(103)));await assert.rejects(dayContext(13,49),e=>e.code==='42501');await assert.rejects(dayContext(781,777,100),e=>e.code==='42501');const ext=await dayContext(14,readerExternalId,100,'external');assert.equal(ext.requires_reason,true);assert.equal(ext.reference,null);});
 await t.test('OPERATIONAL READERS SELECTs run in strict read-only transaction, no modal-write requirement',async()=>{await a.query('BEGIN READ ONLY');try{await a.query("SELECT set_config('test.actor',$1,true),set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub',$1,true)",[id(13)]);await a.query('SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated');const r=(await a.query('SELECT fn_folha_dia_contexto_v3($1::date,$2::uuid,$3::uuid,$4::text) v',[today,id(100),id(777),'primeline'])).rows[0].v;assert.equal(r.person_id,id(777));await a.query('SELECT fn_folha_destinos_contexto_v3() v');}finally{await a.query('ROLLBACK');}});
 await t.test('OPERATIONAL POSTCHECK detects legitimate later ledger drift and rollback isolates next read',async()=>{const before=(await q("SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY request_id),'[]'::jsonb) s FROM folha_privado.operacoes x")).rows[0].s;await a.query('BEGIN');try{await a.query("UPDATE folha_privado.operacoes SET resultado=resultado||'{\"synthetic_drift\":true}'::jsonb WHERE request_id=(SELECT request_id FROM folha_privado.operacoes LIMIT 1)");await assert.rejects(a.query(await read('../supabase/folha_operacional_contextos_postcheck.sql')),e=>e.message.includes('ADDON_DATA_DRIFT'));}finally{await a.query('ROLLBACK');}assert.deepEqual((await q("SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY request_id),'[]'::jsonb) s FROM folha_privado.operacoes x")).rows[0].s,before);await q(await read('../supabase/folha_operacional_contextos_postcheck.sql'));});
 await t.test('RH correction request accepts a reference id/revision with same tenant/person/month proof',async()=>{const r=(await q('SELECT revision FROM folha_referencias WHERE id=$1',[planRef])).rows[0],m=today.slice(0,7)+'-01';const out=await monthOp(10,'devolver',await monthBody(777,m,{records:[{id:planRef,revision:r.revision}],reason:'Conferir os horários da referência original'}));assert.equal(out.conference.estado,'devolvida');assert.equal(out.conference.pedidos_correcao[0].id,planRef);});
 await t.test('TEAM context returns scoped people/references in one read call and no duplicate identities',async()=>{const r=await as(a,13,'SELECT fn_folha_equipa_horas_contexto_v3($1::date,$2::uuid) v',[today,id(100)]);assert.equal(r.version,3);assert.equal(r.date,today);assert.equal(r.work_id,id(100));assert.equal(new Set(r.people.map(x=>x.kind+':'+x.person_id)).size,r.people.length);assert.ok(r.people.find(x=>x.person_id===id(777)).references.length);assert.equal((await q('SELECT count(*)::integer n FROM folha_custos_hora_versoes')).rows[0].n,3);});
 await t.test('EXTERNAL historical inactive identity stays readable and Diretor corrects only existing slot with motive',async()=>{await q('UPDATE folha_externos SET ativo=false WHERE id=$1',[readerExternalId]);const ctx=await dayContext(14,readerExternalId,100,'external');assert.equal(ctx.can_write,true);assert.ok(ctx.name);const row=(await q('SELECT revision FROM folha_registos WHERE externo_id=$1 AND obra_id=$2 AND data=$3',[readerExternalId,id(100),today])).rows[0];const body={version:3,request_id:id(seq++),kind:'external',person_id:readerExternalId,work_id:id(100),date:today,expected_revision:row.revision,reason:'Correção histórica documentada do externo inativo',intervals:[{start:'08:00',end:'12:00',period:'manha',mode:'normal'},{start:'13:00',end:'17:00',period:'tarde',mode:'normal'}]};const out=await dstSave(14,body);assert.equal(out.record.minutes,480);await assert.rejects(dstCall(13,{...body,request_id:id(seq++),expected_revision:out.record.revision}),e=>e.code==='42501');await q('UPDATE folha_externos SET ativo=true WHERE id=$1',[readerExternalId]);});

 await t.test('DESTINATION actor deactivated concurrently is reread after lock, no fact/history write',async()=>{const body=await dstBody(770,102,[custom('10:30','14:30')]);const before=(await q('SELECT to_jsonb(f) v FROM folha_registos f WHERE colaborador_id=$1 AND obra_id=$2 AND data=$3',[id(770),id(102),today])).rows[0].v;const pid=(await a.query('SELECT pg_backend_pid() p')).rows[0].p;let pending,settled=false;await b.query('BEGIN');try{await b.query('UPDATE utilizadores SET ativo=false WHERE id=$1',[id(781)]);pending=dstCall(781,body,false,null,a).then(v=>({value:v}),error=>({error})).finally(()=>{settled=true;});let waiting=false;for(let i=0;i<100;i++){waiting=(await q("SELECT wait_event_type='Lock' waiting FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid=$1",[pid])).rows[0]?.waiting;if(waiting||settled)break;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,10));}assert.equal(waiting,true,'writer must wait for actor lock');await b.query('COMMIT');const r=await pending;assert.ok(r.error);assert.equal(r.error.code,'42501');assert.deepEqual((await q('SELECT to_jsonb(f) v FROM folha_registos f WHERE colaborador_id=$1 AND obra_id=$2 AND data=$3',[id(770),id(102),today])).rows[0].v,before);assert.equal((await q('SELECT count(*)::integer n FROM folha_privado.operacoes WHERE request_id=$1',[body.request_id])).rows[0].n,0);}finally{await b.query('ROLLBACK');if(pending)await pending;await q('UPDATE utilizadores SET ativo=true WHERE id=$1',[id(781)]);}});

 await t.test('DESTINATION concurrent tenant change rejects old company hint after actor lock',async()=>{const body={...await dstBody(770,102,[custom('10:30','14:30')]),company_id:id(1)};const pid=(await a.query('SELECT pg_backend_pid() p')).rows[0].p;let pending,settled=false;await b.query('BEGIN');try{await b.query('UPDATE utilizadores SET empresa_id=$1 WHERE id=$2',[id(2),id(781)]);pending=dstCall(781,body,false,null,a).then(value=>({value}),error=>({error})).finally(()=>{settled=true;});let waiting=false;for(let i=0;i<100;i++){waiting=(await q("SELECT wait_event_type='Lock' waiting FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid=$1",[pid])).rows[0]?.waiting;if(waiting||settled)break;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,10));}assert.equal(waiting,true);await b.query('COMMIT');const r=await pending;assert.equal(r.error?.code,'42501');assert.match(r.error.message,/TENANT_HINT_MISMATCH/);assert.equal((await q('SELECT count(*)::integer n FROM folha_privado.operacoes WHERE request_id=$1',[body.request_id])).rows[0].n,0);}finally{await b.query('ROLLBACK');if(pending)await pending;await q('UPDATE utilizadores SET empresa_id=$1 WHERE id=$2',[id(1),id(781)]);}});

 await t.test('TEAM destination facts remain discoverable without changing principal permanence, strict read-only',async()=>{await a.query('BEGIN READ ONLY');try{await a.query("SELECT set_config('test.actor',$1,true)",[id(781)]);await a.query('SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated');const r=(await a.query('SELECT fn_folha_equipa_horas_contexto_v3($1::date,$2::uuid) v',[today,id(102)])).rows[0].v;const person=r.people.find(x=>x.person_id===id(770));assert.ok(person);assert.equal(person.records.length,1);assert.equal(person.records[0].obra_id,id(102));assert.equal(person.hidden_record_count,1);}finally{await a.query('ROLLBACK');}assert.equal((await q('SELECT obra_id FROM quadro_equipa_permanencias WHERE colaborador_id=$1 AND fim IS NULL',[id(770)])).rows[0].obra_id,id(100));});
